public_definitions: Review the 2005-2014 temperature record and choose the handling route based on whether the period-wide change is large enough to require targeted follow-up or ordinary enough to remain on routine monitoring.
Use the dashboard record as the evidence source for deciding whether the period-wide temperature change warrants targeted follow-up.

uncertain: The point labels include a '$' symbol before the degree value (e.g., '$23.9°C'); it is unclear whether this is a currency symbol, a formatting artifact, or part of the unit, so the values are read as the numeric degree-Celsius figures shown.

No explicit threshold value is printed on the chart or in the supplied definitions to numerically separate 'substantial change' from 'ordinary variation'; the determination of 'large enough' relies on the magnitude of the observed change.
The y-axis does not display gridlines at every tick, so intermediate values are read from the point labels rather than from gridline alignment.
